<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#C9D7CF">
<title>고요로</title>
<style>
  *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
  :root{
    --safe-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
    --safe-bot: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
    --ink:#2B3F35;--ink-2:#46594E;--sub:#6B7C72;
    --sage:#7FA88B;--sage-2:#5F8E73;
    --glass:rgba(255,255,255,.78);
    --glass-border:rgba(255,255,255,.85);
    --rose:#F4A8B5;
  }
  html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#000}
  body{font-family:'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Pretendard','Malgun Gothic',-apple-system,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)}
  .app{position:fixed;inset:0;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
  .bg{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none}
  .bg img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}

  .statusbar{
    position:relative;z-index:5;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
    padding: calc(var(--safe-top) + 12px) 24px 4px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);
  }
  .statusbar .right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-2);font-weight:600}
  .battery{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
  .battery .shell{width:18px;height:9px;border:1px solid currentColor;border-radius:2px;position:relative;padding:1px}
  .battery .shell::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-3px;top:2px;width:2px;height:5px;background:currentColor;border-radius:0 1px 1px 0}
  .battery .lv{height:100%;background:currentColor;border-radius:1px;width:50%}

  .header{position:relative;z-index:5;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:6px 22px 10px}
  .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
  .logo{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:9px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#fff,#C99A56 55%,#6E4A20 100%);box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.15)}
  .brand h1{font-size:15px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink)}
  .brand h1 small{color:var(--sub);font-size:11px;font-weight:500;margin-left:5px;letter-spacing:1px}
  .season{font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-2);padding:6px 12px;background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--glass-border);border-radius:999px;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);font-weight:600}

  .pages{flex:1;position:relative;overflow:hidden;z-index:2;min-height:0}
  .page{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .25s ease;scrollbar-width:none}
  .page::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
  .page.active{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}

  /* 홈 */
  .home-page{display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100%;padding:8px 22px 14px}
  .hero{background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--glass-border);border-radius:26px;padding:22px 20px 18px;backdrop-filter:blur(14px);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(46,75,60,.12);text-align:center}
  .hero h2{font-size:21px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:-.3px;color:var(--ink)}
  .hero h2 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--sage-2)}
  .pill{margin:14px auto 0;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.85);border:1px solid var(--glass-border);font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-2);font-weight:600;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
  .pill .dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--sage);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(127,168,139,.22)}
  .pill b{color:var(--sage-2);font-weight:800}
  .island-area{flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:8px 0}
  .island-img{width:92%;max-width:380px;height:auto;display:block;filter:drop-shadow(0 22px 28px rgba(46,75,60,.28));animation:floaty 6s ease-in-out infinite}
  @keyframes floaty{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-8px)}}
  .duo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px}
  .card{background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--glass-border);border-radius:20px;padding:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;backdrop-filter:blur(14px);box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(46,75,60,.08);cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;text-align:left}
  .card .label{font-size:11px;color:var(--sub);font-weight:600}
  .card h4{font-size:14px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);margin-top:2px;line-height:1.3}
  .card .icon{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.9);border:1px solid var(--glass-border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--sage-2);flex-shrink:0}
  .card .icon svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:currentColor}
  .cta{width:100%;padding:18px 20px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#F7FAF7,#E7EFE8);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(46,75,60,.18), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.9);font-family:inherit;font-size:17px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.4px;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
  .cta:active{transform:scale(.98)}

  .page-content{padding:14px 22px 22px}
  .page-title{font-size:24px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);margin:6px 0 14px}
  .page-title em{font-style:normal;color:var(--sage-2)}
  .glass-card{background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--glass-border);border-radius:18px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:12px;backdrop-filter:blur(14px);box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(46,75,60,.08)}
  .glass-card h4{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}
  .glass-card .meta{font-size:12px;color:var(--sub);margin-top:4px;line-height:1.5}
  .activity-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;cursor:pointer}
  .activity-item .ic{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(201,154,86,.22),rgba(127,168,139,.25));border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:28px;flex-shrink:0}
  .activity-item .info{flex:1}
  .activity-item .info p{font-size:11px;color:var(--sub);margin-top:3px;line-height:1.5}
  .activity-item .chev{color:var(--sub);font-size:18px}
  .stat-big{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:6px;margin-top:8px}
  .stat-big b{font-size:32px;font-weight:800;color:var(--sage-2)}
  .stat-big span{font-size:11px;color:var(--sub)}
  .progress{height:10px;background:rgba(43,63,53,.08);border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:8px}
  .progress > div{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#7FA88B,#C99A56);transition:width .4s ease}


  /* === 지도 페이지 === */
  #page-map{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#E8F2EC 0%,#C9DDD0 100%)}
  .map-page{display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100%;padding:14px 14px 14px}
  .map-title{
    text-align:center;font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);
    padding:8px 0 12px;letter-spacing:-.2px;
  }
  .map-canvas{
    flex:1;min-height:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
    border-radius:18px;border:1px solid var(--glass-border);
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 75% 55%, #87C4E0 0%, #A5D2E5 18%, transparent 25%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 30%, #B5D6B5 0%, #C8E0C5 30%, transparent 60%),
      linear-gradient(180deg, #B5DCE5 0%, #C9E0D2 30%, #B5D6B5 60%, #C8DDC0 100%);
    box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(46,75,60,.12);
  }
  /* 산 (왼쪽) */
  .map-mountain{position:absolute;left:-15px;top:25%;width:140px;height:140px;pointer-events:none}
  /* 호수 영역 */
  .map-lake{position:absolute;right:8%;top:32%;width:48%;height:30%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#87C4E0 0%,#6BB0D8 50%,transparent 90%);border-radius:60% 50% 70% 40%;filter:blur(2px);opacity:.85}
  /* 길/도로 */
  .map-path{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
  /* 나무들 */
  .map-tree{position:absolute;font-size:24px;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.15));pointer-events:none}
  /* POI 핀 */
  .map-pin{
    position:absolute;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;
    transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  }
  .map-pin .head{
    width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.85);border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.95);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:22px;
    box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.18), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6);
    backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
    transition:transform .15s ease;
  }
  .map-pin:hover .head, .map-pin.active .head{transform:scale(1.1)}
  .map-pin .head.tail::after{
    content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:-6px;width:10px;height:10px;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.85);transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(45deg);
    border-right:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.95);border-bottom:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.95);
  }
  .map-pin .label{
    margin-top:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.85);
    padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);
    box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.12);white-space:nowrap;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
  }
  .map-pin.glow .head{background:rgba(180,230,200,.85);box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(127,168,139,.6), 0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
  .map-pin.water .head{background:rgba(180,220,240,.85)}
  .map-pin.warm .head{background:rgba(255,225,195,.85)}

  .map-text-label{
    position:absolute;font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-2);font-weight:600;
    text-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,.8);pointer-events:none;text-align:center;
  }

  /* 하단 정보 카드 */
  .map-info{
    margin-top:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.85);
    border:1px solid var(--glass-border);border-radius:22px;padding:18px 18px 16px;
    backdrop-filter:blur(14px);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(46,75,60,.12);
  }
  .map-info .grip{width:42px;height:4px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(43,63,53,.18);margin:0 auto 12px}
  .map-info .row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .map-info .cur{color:#7CA1C4;font-size:13px;font-weight:700}
  .map-info .cur b{color:#5F89B0}
  .map-info .pt{color:var(--sub);font-size:12px;font-weight:600}
  .map-info .dashline{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:10px 0;color:var(--sub);font-size:10px}
  .map-info .dashline::before{content:"";flex:1;height:0;border-top:1px dashed rgba(43,63,53,.25)}
  .map-info .dest{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);margin-top:2px}
  .map-info .dest small{font-size:14px;color:var(--sub);font-weight:600;margin-left:6px}
  .map-info .meta{font-size:12px;color:#5F8E73;font-weight:700;margin-top:6px}
  .map-info .meta .gray{color:var(--sub);font-weight:500;margin-left:6px}
  .map-info .meta .gray2{color:var(--ink-2);font-weight:600;margin-left:14px}
  .map-info .qrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:8px;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
  .map-info-btn{
    width:100%;margin-top:14px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#F7FAF7,#E7EFE8);
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);border-radius:999px;
    padding:16px 20px;font-family:inherit;font-size:16px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);
    cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;
    box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(46,75,60,.18), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.9);
  }
  .map-info-btn small{font-size:13px;color:var(--sub);font-weight:600;margin-left:6px}
  .map-info-btn:active{transform:scale(.98)}

  .tabbar{position:relative;z-index:5;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);background:rgba(255,255,255,.65);border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);padding-bottom:var(--safe-bot)}
  .tabbar button{background:none;border:none;padding:11px 6px 12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-family:inherit;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--sub);font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
  .tabbar button.active{color:var(--sage-2)}
  .tabbar button .iw{width:40px;height:30px;border-radius:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
  .tabbar button.active .iw{background:rgba(127,168,139,.18)}
  .tabbar button svg{width:20px;height:20px;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8;fill:none}

  /* === 디톡스 시작 오버레이 === */
  .detox-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:100;display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;background-image:url("data:image/jpeg;base64,");background-size:cover;background-position:center;color:#fff;padding: calc(var(--safe-top) + 60px) 32px calc(var(--safe-bot) + 50px)}
  .detox-overlay.show{display:flex;animation:fadeIn .4s ease}
  @keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
  .detox-timer-card{background:rgba(20,22,40,.45);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-radius:22px;padding:22px 28px;backdrop-filter:blur(14px);box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.4);text-align:center;width:100%;max-width:380px}
  .detox-timer-card .lbl{font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:4px}
  .detox-timer-card .time{font-size:38px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;letter-spacing:1px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
  .detox-spacer{flex:1}
  .detox-text{text-align:center;margin-bottom:16px}
  .detox-text .main{font-size:18px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;letter-spacing:.3px;margin-bottom:10px}
  .detox-text .sub{font-size:14px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);letter-spacing:.3px}
  .detox-quit{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);padding:13px 28px;border-radius:999px;font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}

  /* === 정령 알 페이지 (명상 자리) === */
  #page-spirit{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#4D5985 0%,#3A4870 60%,#2C3859 100%)}
  #page-spirit::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 70% 20%, rgba(255,255,255,.25), transparent 35%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 30% 80%, rgba(127,168,139,.18), transparent 40%);pointer-events:none}
  .spirit-page{padding: calc(var(--safe-top) + 12px) 22px 22px;color:#fff;position:relative;z-index:2;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100%}
  .spirit-page .top-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;color:#fff}
  .spirit-page .back{background:none;border:none;color:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
  .spirit-page .top-title{font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
  .spirit-page h2{font-size:42px;font-weight:800;margin-top:24px;letter-spacing:-1px;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
  .spirit-page .sub{font-size:14px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);margin-top:8px}
  .spirit-egg-wrap{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative}
  .spirit-egg{
    width:200px;height:240px;
    background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 35% 30%, #FFF8E8 0%, #F5DCB0 50%, #C8985E 100%);
    border-radius:50% 50% 50% 50% / 60% 60% 40% 40%;
    box-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(255,200,140,.35), inset -10px -20px 40px rgba(140,90,40,.3), inset 8px 12px 30px rgba(255,255,255,.4);
    position:relative;animation:eggBob 4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes eggBob{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-2deg)}50%{transform:translateY(-10px) rotate(2deg)}}
  .spirit-egg::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
    background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 25%, rgba(255,255,255,.5), transparent 30%);border-radius:inherit}
  .spirit-egg-dots{position:absolute;inset:0}
  .spirit-egg-dots span{position:absolute;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#B07A48;opacity:.5}
  .egg-platform{position:absolute;bottom:-30px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:160px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(255,255,255,.35),transparent 70%)}
  .egg-orbit{position:absolute;inset:-40px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);border-radius:50%;animation:spin 8s linear infinite}
  .egg-orbit.r2{inset:-20px -60px;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.18);animation-duration:12s;animation-direction:reverse}
  @keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
  .egg-sparkle{position:absolute;width:3px;height:3px;background:#fff;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 8px #fff}
  .spirit-status{margin-top:20px;color:#fff}
  .spirit-status h3{font-size:18px;font-weight:700}
  .spirit-status p{font-size:14px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);margin-top:6px}
  .spirit-cta{
    margin-top:24px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6EC4B3,#5AA396);
    color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);
    border-radius:999px;padding:18px;font-family:inherit;
    font-size:18px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;
    box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(94,170,150,.4), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.3);
    width:100%;
  }
  .spirit-cta:active{transform:scale(.98)}

  /* === 내 정보 페이지 ===*/
  .profile-section{margin-top:8px}
  .profile-button{
    width:100%;background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--glass-border);
    border-radius:16px;padding:14px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;
    backdrop-filter:blur(14px);box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(46,75,60,.08);
    font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;margin-bottom:10px;
  }
  .profile-button .pic{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:22px;flex-shrink:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(201,154,86,.22),rgba(127,168,139,.25));border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6)}
  .profile-button .info{flex:1}
  .profile-button .info h4{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}
  .profile-button .info p{font-size:11px;color:var(--sub);margin-top:3px}
  .profile-button .chev{color:var(--sub);font-size:18px}

  /* 회원가입 폼 모달 */
  .signup-modal{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:90;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px;background:rgba(46,75,60,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
  .signup-modal.show{display:flex}
  .signup-card{background:#FCFCFA;border-radius:22px;padding:24px 22px;width:100%;max-width:340px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
  .signup-card h3{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:6px;text-align:center}
  .signup-card .desc{font-size:12px;color:var(--sub);text-align:center;margin-bottom:18px}
  .field{margin-bottom:12px}
  .field label{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--sub);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:5px;letter-spacing:.3px}
  .field input{
    width:100%;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid rgba(43,63,53,.15);
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.6);font-family:inherit;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);
    outline:none;transition:border-color .15s ease;
  }
  .field input:focus{border-color:var(--sage);background:#fff}
  .signup-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:18px}
  .btn-secondary{flex:1;padding:13px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--glass-border);background:rgba(255,255,255,.4);color:var(--ink-2);font-family:inherit;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
  .btn-primary{flex:1;padding:13px;border-radius:12px;border:none;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#7FA88B,#5F8E73);color:#fff;font-family:inherit;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
  .btn-primary:active{transform:scale(.98)}
  .toggle-mode{text-align:center;margin-top:14px;font-size:12px;color:var(--sub)}
  .toggle-mode a{color:var(--sage-2);font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none}

  /* === 정령 도감 오버레이 === */
  .dex-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:95;display:none;flex-direction:column;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#E5EEE8 0%,#C9D7CF 50%,#A4B6A9 100%);
    overflow-y:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
  }
  .dex-overlay.show{display:flex;animation:fadeIn .3s ease}
  .dex-overlay::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
  .dex-header{
    position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5;
    padding: calc(var(--safe-top) + 12px) 22px 8px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(229,238,232,.95) 0%,rgba(229,238,232,.6) 100%);
    backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
  }
  .dex-header .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
  .dex-header h2{font-size:30px;font-weight:900;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-1px}
  .dex-actions{display:flex;gap:8px}
  .dex-actions button{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.7);border:1px solid var(--glass-border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;font-size:16px;color:var(--ink-2)}
  .dex-tabs{display:flex;gap:0;margin-top:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);border-radius:999px;padding:4px;border:1px solid var(--glass-border)}
  .dex-tabs button{flex:1;padding:9px 6px;border:none;background:none;font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--sub);cursor:pointer;border-radius:999px;transition:all .2s ease}
  .dex-tabs button.active{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}

  .dex-grid{padding:14px 22px 22px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px}
  .dex-card{
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);border:1px solid var(--glass-border);
    border-radius:16px;padding:12px 8px;text-align:center;
    backdrop-filter:blur(10px);box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(46,75,60,.08);
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;
    position:relative;min-height:160px;
  }
  .dex-card .emo{font-size:54px;line-height:1;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(46,75,60,.15));margin:6px 0 4px}
  .dex-card .nm{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.2}
  .dex-card .desc-small{font-size:10px;color:var(--sub);font-weight:500}
  .dex-card .lvl{font-size:10px;color:var(--sub);font-weight:600;margin-top:auto}
  .dex-badge{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;
    background:rgba(244,168,181,.22);color:#C45067;
    font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:999px;
    border:1px solid rgba(244,168,181,.35);margin-top:4px;
  }
  .dex-locked .emo{filter:grayscale(1) opacity(.35)}
  .dex-locked .nm,.dex-locked .desc-small{opacity:.5}

  .dex-bottom-tabs{position:sticky;bottom:0;z-index:5;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.78);border-top:1px solid var(--glass-border);
    backdrop-filter:blur(16px);padding-bottom:var(--safe-bot);margin-top:auto;
  }
  .dex-bottom-tabs button{background:none;border:none;padding:12px 6px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;color:var(--sub);font-family:inherit;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
  .dex-bottom-tabs button.active{color:var(--ink)}
  .dex-bottom-tabs svg{width:22px;height:22px;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8;fill:none}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="app">

  <!-- 배경 -->
  <div class="bg"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt=""></div>

  <!-- 상태바 -->
  <div class="statusbar">
    <span><span id="clock">--:--</span> <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-2);font-weight:500;margin-left:6px" id="date">--</span></span>
    <span class="right">
      <span>● 횡성</span>
      <span class="battery"><span id="bpct">--%</span><span class="shell"><span class="lv" id="blv"></span></span></span>
    </span>
  </div>

  <!-- 헤더 -->
  <div class="header">
    <div class="brand"><div class="logo"></div><h1>고요로 <small>GOYO-RO</small></h1></div>
    <div class="season">시즌 1 · 봄</div>
  </div>

  <!-- 페이지들 -->
  <div class="pages">

    <!-- 홈 -->
    <div class="page active" id="page-home">
      <div class="home-page">
        <div class="hero">
          <h2>오늘도 <em>고요한 하루</em><br>당신의 마음 챙김, <em>고요</em></h2>
          <div class="pill"><span class="dot"></span><span>현재 디톡스 상태: <b>평온함</b></span></div>
        </div>
        <div class="island-area">
          <img class="island-img" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="">
        </div>
        <div class="duo">
          <button class="card" onclick="switchTab('spirit')">
            <div><div class="label">추천 활동:</div><h4>정령 부화하기</h4></div>
            <div class="icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"/></svg></div>
          </button>
          <button class="card" onclick="switchTab('stats')">
            <div><div class="label">오늘의 기록:</div><h4>3시간 20분</h4></div>
            <div class="icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 21V11M12 21V3M19 21v-7" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></div>
          </button>
        </div>
        <button class="cta" onclick="startDetox(25)">디톡스 시작</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- 지도 (구 활동) -->
    <div class="page" id="page-map">
      <div class="map-page">
        <div class="map-title">횡성 퀘스트 맵</div>

        <!-- 맵 캔버스 -->
        <div class="map-canvas">
          <!-- 산 (왼쪽) -->
          <svg class="map-mountain" viewBox="0 0 140 140">
            <polygon points="0,140 30,40 55,70 70,30 95,80 140,140" fill="#9CB5A4"/>
            <polygon points="20,140 40,55 55,75 140,140" fill="#7C9A87"/>
            <polygon points="60,30 70,12 85,28 80,40" fill="#fff" opacity=".85"/>
          </svg>

          <!-- 호수 -->
          <div class="map-lake"></div>

          <!-- 나무들 (점점이 흩뿌리기) -->
          <span class="map-tree" style="left:8%;top:8%">🌲</span>
          <span class="map-tree" style="left:18%;top:12%;font-size:20px">🌳</span>
          <span class="map-tree" style="left:5%;top:48%">🌲</span>
          <span class="map-tree" style="left:14%;top:55%;font-size:20px">🌳</span>
          <span class="map-tree" style="left:22%;top:68%">🌲</span>
          <span class="map-tree" style="left:45%;top:8%;font-size:20px">🌲</span>
          <span class="map-tree" style="left:38%;top:18%;font-size:18px">🌳</span>
          <span class="map-tree" style="left:54%;top:14%;font-size:20px">🌲</span>
          <span class="map-tree" style="left:62%;top:6%;font-size:18px">🌳</span>
          <span class="map-tree" style="left:35%;top:78%;font-size:20px">🌳</span>
          <span class="map-tree" style="left:48%;top:82%;font-size:20px">🌲</span>
          <span class="map-tree" style="left:62%;top:78%;font-size:18px">🌳</span>
          <span class="map-tree" style="left:78%;top:18%;font-size:18px">🌲</span>
          <span class="map-tree" style="left:88%;top:75%;font-size:20px">🌳</span>
          <span class="map-tree" style="right:5%;top:85%;font-size:20px">🌲</span>

          <!-- 마을 (오른쪽 위) -->
          <span class="map-tree" style="right:10%;top:8%;font-size:26px">🏠</span>
          <span class="map-tree" style="right:3%;top:18%;font-size:22px">🏡</span>
          <span class="map-tree" style="right:18%;top:70%;font-size:24px">🏠</span>

          <!-- POI 핀들 -->
          <button class="map-pin warm active" style="left:30%;top:24%" onclick="selectPOI(this,'beef')">
            <div class="head">🐮</div>
            <div class="label">횡성 한우 거리</div>
          </button>
          <button class="map-pin glow" style="left:62%;top:22%" onclick="selectPOI(this,'trail')">
            <div class="head">🌿</div>
            <div class="label">청태산 둘레길</div>
          </button>
          <button class="map-pin glow" style="left:24%;top:54%" onclick="selectPOI(this,'meditation')">
            <div class="head">🌱</div>
            <div class="label">숲속 명상 쉼터</div>
          </button>
          <button class="map-pin water" style="left:52%;top:52%" onclick="selectPOI(this,'riverside')">
            <div class="head">💧</div>
            <div class="label">강변 산책로</div>
          </button>
          <button class="map-pin warm" style="left:26%;top:80%" onclick="selectPOI(this,'history')">
            <div class="head">⛩️</div>
            <div class="label">역사 유적지</div>
          </button>
          <button class="map-pin warm" style="left:78%;top:62%" onclick="selectPOI(this,'observatory')">
            <div class="head">🔭</div>
            <div class="label">전망대</div>
          </button>

          <!-- 텍스트 라벨 -->
          <div class="map-text-label" style="right:18%;top:38%">수변 공원호</div>
          <div class="map-text-label" style="left:34%;top:67%;width:120px">청태산 둘레길<br><b style="color:var(--ink);font-size:12px">5.2km</b></div>
        </div>

        <!-- 정보 카드 -->
        <div class="map-info">
          <div class="grip"></div>
          <div class="row">
            <span class="cur">현재 위치: <b>청태산 치유의 숲</b></span>
            <span class="pt">16pt</span>
          </div>
          <div class="dashline">dynamic line</div>
          <div class="dest" id="poi-name">횡성 한우 거리 <small id="poi-pt">24pt</small></div>
          <div class="meta">
            <span>추천 코스 보기</span>
            <span class="gray">14pt, 탭하여 정보 확인</span>
            <span class="gray2" id="poi-dist">2.1km (도보 45분)</span>
          </div>
          <div class="qrow"><span style="font-size:16px">🐮</span> 퀘스트 정보: <b style="color:var(--ink-2);font-weight:600;margin-left:2px" id="poi-quest">미식 탐방</b></div>
          <div class="qrow"><span style="font-size:16px">🏅</span> 보상: <span style="margin-left:2px">🪙 <b id="poi-reward">150pt + 배지</b></span></div>
          <button class="map-info-btn" onclick="startDetox(45)">길 안내 시작 <small>20pt</small> →</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- 정령 (명상 자리) -->
    <div class="page" id="page-spirit">
      <div class="spirit-page">
        <div class="top-row">
          <button class="back" onclick="switchTab('home')">‹ 뒤로</button>
          <span class="top-title">고요</span>
          <span style="width:40px"></span>
        </div>
        <h2>정령 알</h2>
        <div class="sub">아직 잠들어 있어요</div>
        <div class="spirit-egg-wrap">
          <div style="position:relative">
            <div class="egg-orbit"></div>
            <div class="egg-orbit r2"></div>
            <div class="spirit-egg">
              <div class="spirit-egg-dots">
                <span style="top:25%;left:30%"></span>
                <span style="top:38%;left:62%"></span>
                <span style="top:55%;left:25%;width:4px;height:4px"></span>
                <span style="top:48%;left:48%;width:4px;height:4px"></span>
                <span style="top:68%;left:55%"></span>
                <span style="top:32%;left:48%;width:3px;height:3px"></span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="egg-platform"></div>
            <span class="egg-sparkle" style="top:0;left:80%"></span>
            <span class="egg-sparkle" style="top:30%;left:-15%"></span>
            <span class="egg-sparkle" style="top:90%;left:90%"></span>
            <span class="egg-sparkle" style="top:60%;left:-10%"></span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="spirit-status">
          <h3>부화 준비 중...</h3>
          <p>명상을 통해 에너지를 모으세요.</p>
        </div>
        <button class="spirit-cta" onclick="startDetox(25)">디톡스 시작</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- 통계 -->
    <div class="page" id="page-stats">
      <div class="page-content">
        <h2 class="page-title">나의 <em>통계</em></h2>
        <div class="glass-card"><h4>이번 시즌 누적 디톡스</h4><div class="stat-big"><b>4h 22m</b><span>/ 목표 10h</span></div><div class="progress"><div style="width:42%"></div></div></div>
        <div class="glass-card"><h4>오늘의 기록</h4><div class="stat-big"><b>3h 20m</b><span>화면 OFF</span></div></div>
        <div class="glass-card"><h4>연속 디톡스 일수</h4><div class="stat-big"><b>7일</b><span>🔥 streak</span></div></div>
        <div class="glass-card"><h4>이번 주 평균 걸음수</h4><div class="stat-big"><b>6,420</b><span>걸음/일</span></div></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- 내 정보 -->
    <div class="page" id="page-profile">
      <div class="page-content">
        <h2 class="page-title"><em>내 정보</em></h2>

        <!-- 로그인 상태 (게스트) -->
        <div class="glass-card" id="guest-card">
          <h4 style="font-size:16px">아직 로그인 안 했어요</h4>
          <div class="meta">회원가입하면 정령과 기록이 영구 저장돼요</div>
          <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:12px">
            <button class="btn-primary" style="flex:1" onclick="openAuth('signup')">회원가입</button>
            <button class="btn-secondary" style="flex:1" onclick="openAuth('login')">로그인</button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- 로그인 후 (숨김 기본) -->
        <div class="glass-card" id="user-card" style="display:none">
          <h4 style="font-size:16px" id="user-nick">공주</h4>
          <div class="meta" id="user-email">시즌 1 멤버 · 가입일 2026.04.20</div>
        </div>

        <div class="profile-section">
          <h4 style="font-size:13px;color:var(--sub);font-weight:700;margin:14px 4px 8px;letter-spacing:.4px">컬렉션</h4>
          <button class="profile-button" onclick="openDex()">
            <div class="pic">📖</div>
            <div class="info"><h4>내 정령 도감</h4><p>14종 중 6종 수집 완료</p></div>
            <div class="chev">›</div>
          </button>

          <h4 style="font-size:13px;color:var(--sub);font-weight:700;margin:14px 4px 8px;letter-spacing:.4px">설정</h4>
          <button class="profile-button"><div class="pic">🔔</div><div class="info"><h4>알림 설정</h4><p>매일 21시 디톡스 리마인더 ON</p></div><div class="chev">›</div></button>
          <button class="profile-button"><div class="pic">🌱</div><div class="info"><h4>디지털 디톡스 등급</h4><p>🌱 새싹 (다음 등급까지 12시간)</p></div><div class="chev">›</div></button>
          <button class="profile-button" onclick="logout()" id="logout-btn" style="display:none"><div class="pic">🚪</div><div class="info"><h4>로그아웃</h4><p>로그아웃하면 게스트로 돌아가요</p></div><div class="chev">›</div></button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 탭바 -->
  <div class="tabbar" id="tabbar">
    <button class="active" data-tab="home" onclick="switchTab('home')"><div class="iw"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 11.5 12 4l9 7.5V20a1 1 0 0 1-1 1h-5v-6h-6v6H4a1 1 0 0 1-1-1Z"/></svg></div>홈</button>
    <button data-tab="map" onclick="switchTab('map')"><div class="iw"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 4l-6 2v14l6-2 6 2 6-2V4l-6 2-6-2zM9 4v14M15 6v14"/></svg></div>지도</button>
    <button data-tab="spirit" onclick="switchTab('spirit')"><div class="iw"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><ellipse cx="12" cy="13" rx="6" ry="8"/></svg></div>정령</button>
    <button data-tab="stats" onclick="switchTab('stats')"><div class="iw"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 21V11M12 21V3M19 21v-7"/></svg></div>통계</button>
    <button data-tab="profile" onclick="switchTab('profile')"><div class="iw"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="8" r="4"/><path d="M4 21c0-4.4 3.6-8 8-8s8 3.6 8 8"/></svg></div>내 정보</button>
  </div>

  <!-- 디톡스 시작 오버레이 -->
  <div class="detox-overlay" id="detoxOverlay">
    <div class="detox-timer-card"><div class="lbl">남은 시간</div><div class="time" id="detoxTime">25:00</div></div>
    <div class="detox-spacer"></div>
    <div class="detox-text"><div class="main">지금은 고요에 집중하는 시간</div><div class="sub">지금은 고요에 집중하는 시간</div></div>
    <button class="detox-quit" onclick="endDetox()">디톡스 종료</button>
  </div>

  <!-- 회원가입/로그인 모달 -->
  <div class="signup-modal" id="authModal">
    <div class="signup-card">
      <h3 id="authTitle">회원가입</h3>
      <div class="desc" id="authDesc">고요로의 회원이 되어 정령을 영구 보관하세요</div>
      <div class="field" id="nickField"><label>닉네임</label><input type="text" id="iNick" placeholder="공주" /></div>
      <div class="field"><label>이메일</label><input type="email" id="iEmail" placeholder="you@example.com" /></div>
      <div class="field"><label>비밀번호</label><input type="password" id="iPw" placeholder="6자 이상" /></div>
      <div class="signup-actions">
        <button class="btn-secondary" onclick="closeAuth()">취소</button>
        <button class="btn-primary" id="authSubmit" onclick="submitAuth()">가입하기</button>
      </div>
      <div class="toggle-mode" id="authToggle">이미 계정이 있나요? <a onclick="setAuthMode('login')">로그인</a></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 정령 도감 오버레이 -->
  <div class="dex-overlay" id="dexOverlay">
    <div class="dex-header">
      <div class="row">
        <h2>정령 도감</h2>
        <div class="dex-actions">
          <button onclick="closeDex()" title="닫기">✕</button>
          <button title="필터">⚙</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="dex-tabs">
        <button class="active" onclick="filterDex(this,'all')">수집 완료</button>
        <button onclick="filterDex(this,'locked')">미수집</button>
        <button onclick="filterDex(this,'new')">업데이트</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="dex-grid" id="dexGrid">
      <!-- 정령 카드들 (JS로 동적 생성) -->
    </div>
    <div class="dex-bottom-tabs">
      <button onclick="closeDex()"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 11.5 12 4l9 7.5V20a1 1 0 0 1-1 1h-5v-6h-6v6H4a1 1 0 0 1-1-1Z"/></svg>홈</button>
      <button class="active"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="4" y="5" width="16" height="15" rx="2"/><path d="M4 10h16"/></svg>도감</button>
      <button><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 12l2 2 4-4M5 5h14v15H5z"/></svg>퀘스트</button>
      <button><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 7h12l-1 13H7L6 7zM9 7V5a3 3 0 0 1 6 0v2"/></svg>상점</button>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>

<script>
  // === 탭 ===
  function switchTab(tab){
    document.querySelectorAll('.page').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.tabbar button').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    const map = {home:'page-home', map:'page-map', spirit:'page-spirit', stats:'page-stats', profile:'page-profile'};
    document.getElementById(map[tab])?.classList.add('active');
    document.querySelector(`.tabbar button[data-tab="${tab}"]`)?.classList.add('active');
  }

  // === 디톡스 ===
  let detoxTimer = null;
  function startDetox(min){
    const ov = document.getElementById('detoxOverlay');
    ov.classList.add('show');
    let sec = min*60;
    const t = document.getElementById('detoxTime');
    const fmt=()=>{t.textContent = String(Math.floor(sec/60)).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(sec%60).padStart(2,'0')};
    fmt();
    clearInterval(detoxTimer);
    detoxTimer = setInterval(()=>{sec--; if(sec<=0){sec=0;fmt();clearInterval(detoxTimer);return} fmt()}, 1000);
  }
  function endDetox(){
    clearInterval(detoxTimer);
    document.getElementById('detoxOverlay').classList.remove('show');
  }

  // === 회원가입/로그인 ===
  let authMode = 'signup';
  function openAuth(mode){
    setAuthMode(mode);
    document.getElementById('authModal').classList.add('show');
  }
  function closeAuth(){document.getElementById('authModal').classList.remove('show')}
  function setAuthMode(mode){
    authMode = mode;
    document.getElementById('authTitle').textContent = mode === 'signup' ? '회원가입' : '로그인';
    document.getElementById('authDesc').textContent = mode === 'signup' ? '고요로의 회원이 되어 정령을 영구 보관하세요' : '돌아오신 걸 환영해요';
    document.getElementById('nickField').style.display = mode === 'signup' ? 'block' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('authSubmit').textContent = mode === 'signup' ? '가입하기' : '로그인';
    document.getElementById('authToggle').innerHTML = mode === 'signup'
      ? '이미 계정이 있나요? <a onclick="setAuthMode(\'login\')">로그인</a>'
      : '처음 오셨나요? <a onclick="setAuthMode(\'signup\')">회원가입</a>';
  }
  function submitAuth(){
    const nick = document.getElementById('iNick').value || '공주';
    const email = document.getElementById('iEmail').value || 'guest@goyoro.com';
    const pw = document.getElementById('iPw').value;
    if(authMode === 'signup' && (!nick || !email || pw.length < 6)){
      alert('닉네임/이메일/비밀번호(6자+) 모두 입력해주세요');
      return;
    }
    if(authMode === 'login' && (!email || !pw)){
      alert('이메일과 비밀번호를 입력해주세요');
      return;
    }
    // 가입/로그인 시뮬레이션
    document.getElementById('guest-card').style.display = 'none';
    const uc = document.getElementById('user-card');
    uc.style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('user-nick').textContent = nick;
    document.getElementById('user-email').textContent = email + ' · 시즌 1 멤버';
    document.getElementById('logout-btn').style.display = 'flex';
    closeAuth();
  }
  function logout(){
    document.getElementById('guest-card').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('user-card').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('logout-btn').style.display = 'none';
  }

  // === 정령 도감 ===
  const SPIRITS = [
    {emo:'🥯', name:'A흥 찐빵 찐', desc:'찐빵 정령', got:true},
    {emo:'🐄', name:'한우 방구', desc:'아기 소', got:true},
    {emo:'🦦', name:'달콤 수달', desc:'수달 정령', got:true},
    {emo:'🐰', name:'복숭아 토끼', desc:'토끼 정령', got:true},
    {emo:'💧', name:'맑은 시냇물 수달', desc:'물의 정령', got:true},
    {emo:'🌱', name:'이슬 머금은 숲', desc:'이슬 정령', got:true},
    {emo:'🌾', name:'황금빛 들판 벼', desc:'벼 정령', got:false, lvl:5},
    {emo:'🌾', name:'황금빛 들판 벼', desc:'벼 정령', got:false, lvl:5},
    {emo:'☁️', name:'구름 정령', desc:'바람 정령', got:false, lvl:5},
    {emo:'👻', name:'산딸기 요정', desc:'베리 정령', got:false, lvl:5},
    {emo:'🧚', name:'산딸기 요정', desc:'베리 정령', got:false, lvl:5},
    {emo:'🐄', name:'등실등실 한우', desc:'한우 정령', got:false, lvl:5},
    {emo:'🐿️', name:'산들바람 다람쥐', desc:'다람쥐 정령', got:false, lvl:5},
    {emo:'🌕', name:'밤하늘 달', desc:'달 정령', got:false, lvl:5}
  ];

  function renderDex(filter){
    const grid = document.getElementById('dexGrid');
    grid.innerHTML = '';
    SPIRITS.forEach(s => {
      const isLocked = !s.got;
      if(filter === 'all' && isLocked && !s.lvl) return; // 수집 완료 탭
      if(filter === 'locked' && !isLocked) return;       // 미수집 탭
      const div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = 'dex-card' + (isLocked ? ' dex-locked' : '');
      div.innerHTML = `
        <div class="emo">${s.emo}</div>
        <div class="nm">${s.name}</div>
        <div class="desc-small">${s.desc}</div>
        ${s.lvl ? `<div class="lvl">Lv. ${s.lvl}</div>` : ''}
        ${s.got ? '<div class="dex-badge">★ 획득 완료</div>' : ''}
      `;
      grid.appendChild(div);
    });
  }
  function filterDex(btn, filter){
    document.querySelectorAll('.dex-tabs button').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    btn.classList.add('active');
    renderDex(filter);
  }
  function openDex(){
    document.getElementById('dexOverlay').classList.add('show');
    renderDex('all');
  }
  function closeDex(){
    document.getElementById('dexOverlay').classList.remove('show');
  }

  // === 지도 POI 선택 ===
  const POI_DATA = {
    beef:        {name:'횡성 한우 거리',  pt:24, dist:'2.1km (도보 45분)', quest:'미식 탐방',  reward:'150pt + 배지'},
    trail:       {name:'청태산 둘레길',  pt:18, dist:'5.2km (도보 95분)', quest:'트레킹',     reward:'200pt + 배지'},
    meditation:  {name:'숲속 명상 쉼터', pt:12, dist:'1.3km (도보 22분)', quest:'명상 30분',  reward:'80pt + 정령 알'},
    riverside:   {name:'강변 산책로',    pt:16, dist:'2.8km (도보 50분)', quest:'사운드 수집', reward:'120pt'},
    history:     {name:'역사 유적지',    pt:22, dist:'3.6km (도보 65분)', quest:'문화 탐방',  reward:'180pt + 배지'},
    observatory: {name:'전망대',         pt:30, dist:'4.4km (도보 80분)', quest:'별빛 명상',  reward:'250pt + 정령 알'}
  };
  function selectPOI(btn, key){
    document.querySelectorAll('.map-pin').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
    btn.classList.add('active');
    const d = POI_DATA[key];
    if(!d) return;
    document.getElementById('poi-name').firstChild.textContent = d.name + ' ';
    document.getElementById('poi-pt').textContent = d.pt + 'pt';
    document.getElementById('poi-dist').textContent = d.dist;
    document.getElementById('poi-quest').textContent = d.quest;
    document.getElementById('poi-reward').textContent = d.reward;
  }


  // === 시계 + 배터리 ===
  const DOW = ['일','월','화','수','목','금','토'];
  function tick(){
    const d = new Date();
    document.getElementById('clock').textContent = d.getHours()+':'+String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0');
    document.getElementById('date').textContent = (d.getMonth()+1)+'월 '+d.getDate()+'일 ('+DOW[d.getDay()]+')';
  }
  tick(); setInterval(tick, 30*1000);
  if(navigator.getBattery){
    navigator.getBattery().then(b=>{
      const r=()=>{const p=Math.round(b.level*100);document.getElementById('bpct').textContent=p+'%';document.getElementById('blv').style.width=p+'%'};
      r(); b.addEventListener('levelchange',r); b.addEventListener('chargingchange',r);
    });
  } else { document.getElementById('bpct').textContent='—';document.getElementById('blv').style.width='50%'; }
</script>
</body>
</html>
